verdict.rationale: Activepieces supports self-hosting (Docker/own infrastructure) and explicitly mentions an 'EU cloud' option alongside running 'entirely inside your own network,' giving users some control over where data lives, but there's no documentation of a broader menu of cloud regions or formal data-residency/compliance guarantees beyond that single EU mention. Missing for 10: multiple named cloud regions, explicit data-residency/compliance certifications, and any UI/setting for choosing region within the hosted product.
